title: Do LLMs exhibit human-like response biases? A case study in survey design
reasoning: The paper focuses on survey design and social psychology, investigating whether LLMs exhibit the same response biases (like acquiescence or response order bias) as humans. While the survey questions used as stimuli cover various social and political topics that may involve ethics (e.g., human rights, abortion), the research goal is to evaluate the methodology of using LLMs as human proxies in surveys rather than to benchmark or evaluate moral, ethical, or religious systems.
